create_generalized_rcnn_model: create a generalized R-CNN model that supports Fast R-CNN, Faster R-CNN, and Mask R-CNN via configuration
build_generic_detection_model: build a data parallel detection model with configurable backbone, ROI box head, mask head, and keypoint head
create_model_with_create: create a detection model by dispatching to a named model builder function with optional GPU targeting
add_training_inputs: add training input blobs and a RoIDataLoader to an already built model for multi-GPU training
add_inference_inputs: add inference input blobs to the model network including mask and keypoint sub-networks if enabled
